notes.title: Zombie Slayer Returns
notes.notes:
Hey gang!

Space Robot Samurai Zombie Slayer is a pretty cool little game. I enjoyed making it and a lot of people have enjoyed playing it. But I'm sure some people would have liked more, right? Well, now there is more! Space Ghost Pirate Zombie Slayer, the sequel to Space Robot Samurai Zombie Slayer, is now out on Steam! More space, more zombies, more slaying. Everything you loved about Space Robot Samurai Zombie Slayer, but more of it!

You can check out Space Ghost Pirate Zombie Slayer right here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/553350

I hope you all enjoy it! Thanks for the support!

-Brandon Brizzi
@OutManOdd
